v17-9.candidate: For behold, now he is hiding in one of the hills or in some other place. When he falls upon them at the outset, whoever hears will say, ‘There has been a crushing defeat among the people following Absalom.’

v17-11.candidate: For this is the counsel I have given: all Israel will gather to you, from Dan to Beersheba, as numerous as the sand beside the sea, with you yourself going in their midst.

v18-10.candidate: A man saw it and told Joab, “Behold, I have seen Absalom hanging in the oak.”

v18-11.candidate: Joab said to the man reporting to him, “Behold, you saw him! Why did you not strike him to the ground? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a belt.”

v18-12.candidate: The man said to Joab, “Even if I weigh a thousand silver shekels in my hands, I will certainly not put out my hand against the king’s son. For in our hearing the king commanded you, Abishai, and Ittai, ‘Guard the young man Absalom for me,

v18-13.candidate: so as to do no wrong against his life.’ Nothing will escape the king’s notice, and you yourself will stand opposite me.”

v18-24.candidate: David was sitting between the two gates. The watchman went up to the gate roof by the wall, raised his eyes, and saw, and behold, a man running alone before him.

v18-31.candidate: Behold, Cushi arrived and said to the king, “Let my lord the king receive good news: the Lord has vindicated you today against the hand of all who rose against you.”

v18-3.candidate: They said, “You must not go out. For if we flee, they will pay no attention to us; if half of us die, they will pay no attention to us. For you are worth ten thousand of us. It is better now for you to be a help to us in the city.”
